posts.text:
Had a great time campaigning in Minneapolis with @peggyflanagan ! The energy on the ground is HIGH. 

We need bold leaders who will fight for working people and push big ideas like Medicare for All while refusing to take corporate PAC money.
posts.summary: Supports bold leaders rejecting corporate PAC money, backing Medicare for All

posts.text: I’m in Minnesota! This morning, I joined @LittleCongress on the campaign trail. We met with folks impacted by ICE, joined volunteers for a meet & greet, & stopped by a data center to stand against its construction. Minnesota needs Matt in Congress & I’m proud to support him.
posts.summary: Endorses Matt Devitt's congressional campaign, opposes ICE enforcement
